impressions.text: The work implemented scope approval gates for issue execution, binding approval to a reviewed body hash and adding issue-edit and scope-review commands.
The worker reported broad test and check coverage, including a passing full test run and green CI.

The orchestrator’s first review caught that orchestrator comments prevented the trivial-issue shortcut and that quoted body hashes should be accepted; the worker reported fixes and regression tests for both.
The worker escalated uncertainty about the GitHub approval-event wire shape rather than bypassing the access boundary; the orchestrator supplied a live recording, resolving the blocker.
The worker also reported that the recorded hand-posted hash did not match the captured body bytes, and that live issue/card state was not changed.

roundCauses.text: Review round 1 requested fixes for the trivial-issue shortcut’s treatment of orchestrator comments and support for backtick-wrapped hashes.

findings.text: The worker reported the captured body hash and hand-posted scope-review hash differed, with the latter matching a body projection containing an extra trailing newline.
